title: Custom-token mint in the legacy layout [mint, admin, to]: three topics, the second is the token itself
why: A custom token (not a Stellar Asset Contract) emits mint with the pre-CAP-67 SEP-41 layout [mint, admin, to], three topics like the CAP-67 SAC form [mint, to, asset] but in another order. Readers that apply the SAC layout to every three-topic mint credit the admin (here the token contract itself) and read the recipient as the asset.

values.note: Legacy layout: the admin (the token contract) then the recipient.

notes: Apply index 259 of 306; envelope stage 0, cluster 0, position 64 (fee bump: GBVVWAJ7… pays 49334, refunded 10592). GB33GDOK… deposits 400000 USDC (its trustline goes to 0) into the vault token CCA2ZJP5…, which mints 369299 of its own token to GB33GDOK…; the mint's admin topic is CCA2ZJP5… itself. The USDC Stellar Asset Contract CCW67TSZ… (derived.contracts) stores the vault's USDC balance in its own contract data. The count 0 movement pins the misreading that credits the admin. go-stellar-sdk#6004 (open) concerns this misreading in the token transfer processor; it has not been run against this ledger. Written live by stellar-core 29.0.0.
